notices.title: Mid-Semester Examination Timetable
notices.description: The mid-semester examination timetable is available. Students should check their department schedule and contact the academic office if they notice a clash.

notices.title: Library Hours During Examination Week
notices.description: The central library will remain open until 9:00 PM during examination week. Please carry your university ID card.

notices.title: VLSI and Embedded Systems Workshop
notices.description: Registration is open for the hands-on workshop on VLSI design and embedded systems. Interested students should register with their department coordinator.

notices.title: Scholarship Document Verification
notices.description: Students applying for scholarships should submit the required documents to the student welfare office before the announced deadline.

notices.title: Sports Club Registrations
notices.description: Registrations are open for university sports clubs. Students can sign up for cricket, badminton, volleyball, athletics, and chess.
